title: Efficient Energy-Constrained Semi-Device-Independent QRNG with an Integrated Heterodyne Receiver
summary: Semi-device-independent QRNG frameworks represent a particularly attractive approach, combining strong security guarantees with high randomness generation rates while relying only on reduced and practical physical assumptions. A recently proposed approach based on photon-number constraints is particularly suited to photonic implementations, where these assumptions can be easily assessed experimentally.
